segments.title: January
segments.text: Hello Kemps Corner! Happy New Year, team. January is the one month when people walk in already wanting to change. Our theme is Resolutions with Receipts: we help people keep the promise, not just make it.

segments.title: ₹33L
segments.text: So, the number. Our January target for Kemps Corner is 33 lakh rupees. That's 20 per cent up on last January. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 18.1 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 7.92 lakh, comebacks 3.96 lakh, and everything else 2.97 lakh. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 71 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 518 leads, 264 trials, and 71 buyers, with about 27 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.
Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 23.4 lakh rupees, which is 71 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: The 57-Hour Hangover Sale
segments.text: First up, the 57-Hour Hangover Sale. One month unlimited at a flat price, for fifty-seven hours only, with a capped number of memberships. It vanishes faster than everyone's New Year's Eve plans. The plan is 24 buyers at about 15,000, so 3.6 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Everyone, while the capped stock lasts; one per person.

segments.title: Third Time's the Charm
segments.text: Next, Third Time's the Charm. Three classes for the price of two. The first class is awkward, the second is better, the third, they're hooked. Book class two before they leave class one. The plan is 30 buyers at about 17,200, so 5.16 lakh rupees.

segments.title: U Up? It's 2027.
segments.text: Then, for lapsed members, U Up? It's 2027. Fifteen per cent off to come back, and five bonus days for anyone who hits twelve classes in January. Their mat has been asking about them. The plan is 20 buyers at about 17,200, so 3.44 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Standard lapsed 15%, bonus earned (≈20% effective if earned)

segments.title: The Baker's Dozen
segments.text: And finally, for our loyal annual members, The Baker's Dozen. Renew your annual and get a thirteenth month, plus privates, guest passes and monthly trainer check-ins. Twelve months is so last year. The plan is 6 buyers at about 1.87 lakh, so 11.2 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, the flash sale opens, and the clock does the selling. Week two, every first-timer books class two before leaving class one. Week three, we personally call every lapsed member on the list. Week four, February expiries get their Baker's Dozen conversation.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's January at Kemps Corner. 33 lakh rupees, four offers, and 71 buyers to welcome. Resolutions fade by February. Our receipts won't.
